title: pinus montana var. eumughus
intro: Pinus montana var. eumughus, commonly known as Bhutan Pine, is a plant species native to the Himalayas, characterized by its unique conical shape and aromatic wood. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus montana var. eumughus include analgesia, antisepticism, and anti-inflammation, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities, making the Bhutan Pine a valuable resource for natural medicine.
